svg.text: 4×4 differential crossbar — theory of operation (0013)
matrix-vector product in conductance · superposition of 8 half-column TIA stages · behavioral equivalence to the analog_llm tile
1 · the array computes a matrix-vector product
Vout_j = Rf · Σ_i u_i · (G+_ij − G−_ij) = Rf · Gscale · (W @ u)_j
u_i = x_i − VREF, W_ij = (G+_ij − G−_ij)/Gscale ∈ [−1, 1], Rf·Gscale = 1 V per volt per weight
with VREF = 2.5 V, G0 = Gscale = 0.1 mS, Rf = 10 kΩ (the 0007 column constants, unchanged)
2 · each cell is a differential conductance pair
G+_ij
G−_ij
w_ij·Gscale
G+_ij = G0 + max(0, w_ij)·Gscale, G−_ij = G0 + max(0, −w_ij)·Gscale
zero weight → both conductances sit at G0 and the cell sinks exactly 0 net current (balanced zero)
3 · every column is an independent 0007 column, solved by superposition
a 4×4 array is 8 independent TIA half-columns (4 columns × G+ / G−). Each half-column is a
linear network sharing only the input sources and VREF, so each is solved in its own netlist and
combined: Vout_j = Vm_j − Vp_j. Columns are uncoupled by construction (verified 0.0e+00 V).
4 · hand-computable example (case 0, W_MIXED · u0)
SPICE: −0.03725 V · hand: −0.03750 V · |err| = 2.5e-4 V (VCVS finite-gain, as in 0007)
5 · behavioral equivalence: SPICE ↔ hand ↔ analog_llm tile
the CrossbarTile (16-bit conductance/converter quantization on the validated crossbar-column-v1 profile)
is the architecture simulator's model of this array. Over the 5-case × 4-output suite:
|SPICE − hand| worst 5.5e-4 V (rms 3.3e-4) · |tile − hand| worst 3.8e-5 V (rms 2.8e-5)
|SPICE − tile| worst 5.2e-4 V (rms 3.1e-4) — tile error is its quantization floor, well under the
frozen R3 budget of 2e-3 V; the tile is a faithful behavioral model of the SPICE array.
6 · currents, headroom, settling — what is claimed vs recorded
column currents Iplus_j = Σ_i u_i·G+_ij (SPICE-recovered via (VREF − Vp_j)/Rf): worst |err| 1.8e-7 A
largest cell current 1.0e-4 A (feasibility bound |u|_max·(G0+Gscale)) · max |Vout| 0.50 V ≪ 2.5 V headroom
virtual ground within 3.0e-4 V of VREF; the 0012 half-stage rail finding carries over (|u| ≤ 1.25 V for |w|=1)
settling at assumed CL = 1 pF: recorded data point only (22.7 ns SPICE vs 13.2 ns single-pole bound) — the
ideal VCVS has no bandwidth model, so it is NOT a settling claim (bounded settling is the 0014 gate item)
evidence classes: SPICE MVM/currents = spice · tile equivalence = derived · settling = assumed (extract only, fails closed)
